Maya (Recruiter): Heads-up: Lina M accepted our offer for 2026-04-06 start. She just told me her EAD expires 2026-04-08 and renewal was filed 3/18. Can we onboard if renewal pending? :thinking_face:
Priya - People Ops: Short answer: not for paid work. We can do orientation and non-billable access. Need to collect the I-797C (receipt) and passport + current EAD scan. Also checking if premium filing was used.
Sam G (Payroll): Payroll policy requires proof of valid work auth before first paid paycheck is set. If we have I-797C and biometrics, we can create a provisional folder but cannot process payment until clearance. If EAD arrives mid-payroll we can retro-pay if docs are in before payroll close.
Ravi K (Hiring Manager): Oof. Team has sprint planning on 4/7 and client demos starting 4/12. Can we do a partial remote onboarding to keep timeline?
Priya - People Ops: We can allow Slack access, repo read permissions, onboarding modules, and scheduled 1:1s. No commit access or client-facing tasks. We'll prepare a written addendum that makes the start "contingent on work authorization" and lists allowed activities.
Lina M (New Hire): I did file renewal and completed biometrics on 3/30. I have the I-797C and biometrics confirmation PDF. Uploading now to the portal. Is there anything else you need?
people-ops-bot: Document uploaded by Lina M: i797c_reciept_33026.pdf (stored to HR secure bucket) :white_check_mark:
Priya - People Ops: Thanks Lina. Please also upload passport page and EAD front/back. Maya, please loop Legal to confirm we can run unpaid orientation and the specific wording for the addendum.
Maya (Recruiter): Looping Legal now. @Legal-Team can you confirm allowed activities during pending EAD and sign off on the addendum template?
Sam G (Payroll): Also flagging payroll cutoff dates: our next cutoff is 4/15. If clearance isn't confirmed by then, first payday will be next cycle and we may need to run manual exception. Lina, keep us posted if you get an I-766 or new card.
Lina M (New Hire): Quick Q: if the EAD shows up after I start orientation but before 4/15, will I get pay backdated to my start?
Sam G (Payroll): If final docs are in before payroll processing close (4/18 EOD), yes we can retro-pay to the start date. Otherwise pay will start on the clearance date. We'll confirm once legal signs off.
Priya - People Ops: Two options for you, Ravi: 1) Move official paid start to 4/12 to avoid payroll risk, or 2) keep 4/6 as "orientation-only" unpaid, convert to paid once EAD arrives. Which do you prefer?
Ravi K (Hiring Manager): Prefer option 2 if Legal okays it. We can run onboarding week and shadowing without billable work. Keeps momentum.
Priya - People Ops: Great. I'll draft a contingent start addendum and message Lina. Addendum will include: allowed activities list, required docs upload instructions, payroll retro-pay conditions, and expense reimbursement policy for premium processing if candidate requests.
Maya (Recruiter): Lina, is premium processing an option? If you want company to consider reimbursement per policy, let us know and save receipts.
Lina M (New Hire): Thanks, I didn't use premium. If it makes sense later I may request reimbursement.
people-ops-bot: Reminder created: "Check Lina M EAD status" on 2026-04-02 09:00
Priya - People Ops: Action items:
- Lina: upload passport + EAD scans and confirm travel plans if any.
- Maya: follow up with Legal and share addendum draft.
- Sam: mark payroll for potential retro-pay exception and hold notes.
Maya (Recruiter): I'll get the addendum to Lina today and ping Legal. ETA EOD.
Lina M (New Hire): Uploaded passport + EAD scans. Thanks everyone :pray:
Priya - People Ops: Thanks team. I'll post final signed addendum here once executed. :thumbsup:
